angle: Writing a dress code people will actually understand
caption:
Guests keep texting to ask what formal attire means kasi vague dress codes on paper cards confuse everyone.

· Print exact color swatches directly on the craft card
· Avoid confusing terms like semi-formal or festive
· Mention grass-friendly footwear for outdoor venues
